description: Linux x86_64 OpenGL 4.5 core on a real GPU (RFC 0016 K10; RFC 0005 Q-PRESENTATION). Suites link libEGL and make their own surfaceless context (EGL_MESA_platform_surfaceless), so no window reaches a desktop and no display is needed. Runs only on a runner with a physical GPU (`--runner gpu`); LIBGL_ALWAYS_SOFTWARE=1 in the environment selects Mesa's llvmpipe instead, an additional configuration, not a replacement.

generated_include_roots.description: RFC 0016 K4/K10: the SPIR-V and GLSL 4.50 headers the build generates (not committed); sources include "spv/<name>"
